text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Morning. In order to finish the work left over from yesterday,
I headed to the Trainer's Room early—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you still alive!?
You don't have a hole in your stomach, do you!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: T-Thank goodness...! So that really was a dream, then...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So neither a Trainer brainwashed by an evil syndicate
nor one blown to smithereens taking the enemy's ultimate attack for me exists...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, from early in the morning, I had to soothe a bawling Kawakami Princess..."
